title: WEAPON DROPS ARE RARE
why: His answer 15 c: weapon drops rarely. Guns turned up in a good share of lockers, safes and caches and in pillager bags. Now each of those guns has a 40 percent chance to stay a gun; the rest become a valuable of the same rarity, so a box holds as many things as before and is worth about the same, but a gun is a real find. A pillager still carries and drops the gun in his hands. DEMO and CAREER are the same, and the map, the enemies and the boxes are otherwise exactly as before.
now: Guns are now a rare find: most guns in boxes and pillager bags are replaced by a valuable of the same rarity.
